acquired_segments.title: One Piece Card Game - Collection Tour!!!!!!
acquired_segments.visual_evidence: Inspected source-resolution frames show two different populated 3x3 binder spreads, with about 18 physical card faces per spread; the selected frames repeat each spread during hand movement/page handling. Whole video view includes room clutter, displayed computer monitors and hands. No usable exact identities are asserted.
quality_limits: Binder-page view is wide and tilted; individual cards are relatively small in the 4K frame.
Hands obscure pockets during turns; moderate reflections and room/monitor background are visible.
Visual text is not treated as verified identity evidence.
acquired_segments.timestamp_caveat: 248-264 are requested yt-dlp section bounds. Keyframe/container seeking can shift decoded clip start; frame manifest times are relative to the extracted clip and reported-fps index, not guaranteed frame-accurate source timestamps.

acquired_segments.title: STUNNING CARDS! Opening 2 Boxes of OP12! 4K Legacy of the Master
acquired_segments.visual_evidence: Storyboard and inspected source-resolution frames show sequential physical English One Piece cards held close to camera; at least eight distinct card-face presentations are visible across the selected temporal samples, count approximate and card identities unresolved. Main held card is large enough for an individual crop and printed text/artwork is sharp in inspected frames.
quality_limits: Persistent presenter picture-in-picture occupies the upper-right portion of the frame and must be excluded from card crops.
Fingers occlude card edges; other cards in the background may be blurry.
Single-card reveal footage is supplementary and does not model binder-page localization.

overall_result: Two distinct previously unacquired public sources were format-verified and sampled. One supplies useful binder-page frames and one supplies sharp held-card frames.
